overview_description.description: Stacklok enables you to trust and empower knowledge workers with AI agents that are connected to your sensitive systems and data. It is a self-hosted, Kubernetes native platform for AI agent governance. Stacklok offers the building blocks of agentic workflows (MCP servers, skills, environments, harnesses, etc), so your internal experts have the tools to create value, share with peers and accelerate adoption of AI. Our Applied AI Engineers embed with your team from pilot to production to ensure you achieve your business objectives and use AI agents + knowledge workers as a competitive advantage.
